instruction:
Using the Jolpica F1 response for the winner of round 1 of the 2024 season, report raceName, race date, circuitName, winning driver, constructor, grid position, laps, status, and every field in the winner's FastestLap object.

Stopping condition: Stop after all requested race and winning-result fields, including the complete FastestLap object, have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the supplied JSON response.
- Read the single race in MRData.RaceTable.Races and the single returned result in its Results array.
- Keep fastest-lap rank, lap, time, average-speed value, and units separate.
- Preserve names, date, numbers, status, and units exactly as returned.
